D: Young Han Solo joins a crew of thieves and meets Chewbacca and Lando on the way.
P: Serve the snacks when Han sits down at the card table with Lando.
S: Roasted almonds and cashews with rosemary and smoked salt, and a bowl of marinated olives on the card table.
Cubes of aged cheddar and gouda rolled in toasted sesame and paprika, served on toothpicks with quince paste.
Pork and cabbage dumplings pan-fried until crisp underneath, steamed with a splash of water, chilli oil and black vinegar to dip.
M: Crackling pork knuckles roasted slowly with caraway, served with sauerkraut and mustard. Simmer 2 pork knuckles with an onion, bay and caraway for 1.5 hours.
the glittering party on Dryden's yacht
Duck breasts scored and rendered skin side down, finished in the oven, sliced over celeriac purée with a cherry and port sauce.
W: the fuel they're stealing is unstable
Dark chocolate bark scattered with popping candy, freeze-dried raspberries and sea salt. Melt 300g dark chocolate and spread thin on a lined tray.
K: Lando and his collection of capes
Bourbon stirred with honey syrup and orange bitters over a big ice cube, with orange peel.

s.how: Toss 150g almonds and 150g cashews with a little oil, chopped rosemary and smoked salt. Roast at 180C for 10 minutes. Serve warm in one bowl beside a second bowl of mixed green and kalamata olives on the card table.

Mix 400g pork mince with finely shredded wombok, grated ginger and salt. Fill dumpling wrappers and pleat closed. Fry in oil until crisp underneath, add a splash of water, cover and steam 5 minutes. Serve with chilli oil and black vinegar.

m.how: Simmer 2 pork knuckles with an onion, bay and caraway for 1.5 hours. Pat dry, rub with salt and roast at 220C for 45 minutes until crackling. Serve with 500g warm sauerkraut, mustard and potatoes.

w.note: the fuel they're stealing is unstable
w.how: Melt 300g dark chocolate and spread thin on a lined tray. Scatter with 2 sachets popping candy, 15g freeze-dried raspberries and sea salt flakes. Set in the fridge and snap into shards.

d.note: Lando and his collection of capes
d.how: Stir a spoon of honey into a little warm water to make a syrup. For each drink, stir 60ml bourbon, 10ml honey syrup and 2 dashes orange bitters with ice, then strain over one big ice cube. Twist a strip of orange peel over the top.
